map.：草鱼种均重 50 g、水温 18℃、运输 4 小时：低温下代谢较低，开放式鱼篓: : grass carp fry averaging 50 g, water 18℃, 4 hours transport: at low temperature metabolism is lower and open baskets allow about 200~250 kg/m³; with sealed aerated bags and ice cooling to 12℃ the density can rise to 300~400 kg/m³. Beyond 6 hours or above 25℃ the density must be lowered and aeration increased.
map.运输密度是不是越低越好？: Is a lower transport density always better?
map.并非越低越好。密度过低水体小、水质波动与鱼体碰撞应激反而大；应在保证溶氧与氨氮可: Lower is not always better. Too low a density means a small water body with more water quality fluctuation and greater collision stress; choose an economic density while keeping dissolved oxygen and ammonia controllable. Generally short hauls run 200~300 kg/m³, and longer hauls with temperature control and aeration can go higher — adjust by species and water temperature.
map.运输途中如何判断缺氧风险？: How do you judge hypoxia risk during transport?
map.观察鱼浮头、狂游、体色发暗、聚集水面急促呼吸即为缺氧征兆。预防靠控制密度、持续增: Watching for fish surfacing, erratic swimming, darkening body colour and clustering at the surface with rapid breathing indicates hypoxia. Prevention relies on controlling density, continuous aeration (pure oxygen is better), cooling to lower metabolism, and regular water exchange or topping up during long hauls.
